Interface HttpRouteBuilder

All Superinterfaces:
HttpRouteScope
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultHttpRouteBuilder
public sealed interface HttpRouteBuilder extends HttpRouteScope permits DefaultHttpRouteBuilder
Builds routes to handler functions: in an HttpRoutes bean, which adds them to the application routes. A handler route runs like a controller route: argument binding, filters, error routes, executor selection, 405 / 415 / 406, CORS and implicit HEAD routes all apply.

A route is declared in stages: a creator, e.g. HttpRouteScope.GET(String), gives the pending route, an HttpRouteSpec, which takes the settings of the route, then optionally a body stage, and one terminal, the handler or the response of the route, which adds the route. A route with no settings has a shortcut per method, e.g. HttpRouteScope.GET(String, RequestHandler).

routes.GET("/items/{id}", (request, pathVariables) -> HttpResponse.ok(items.find(pathVariables.getLong("id"))));
routes.GET("/items/{id}/name")
    .produces(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN_TYPE)
    .executeOn(TaskExecutors.BLOCKING)
    .handle((request, pathVariables) -> HttpResponse.ok(items.find(pathVariables.getLong("id")).name()));
routes.POST("/items").body(Item.class).handle((request, pathVariables, item) -> HttpResponse.created(items.save(item)));
routes.error(NoSuchFileException.class, (request, error) -> HttpResponse.notFound());

A pending route that is not ended with a terminal fails the startup: an IllegalStateException names the route and the HttpRoutes bean that declares it, once HttpRoutes.routes(HttpRouteBuilder) returned, or once the lambda of the group that declares it returned.

Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • serverFilter

      ServerFilterSpec serverFilter(String... patterns)
      Declare a server filter, the functional form of a @ServerFilter bean: it filters every request whose path matches one of the patterns, e.g. /** or /api/**, whatever answers it, a controller, a handler route or a static resource, including the requests no route matches, ordered together with the filter beans. It is global: only the builder of an HttpRoutes bean declares server filters, a HttpRouteGroup declares route filters, which apply to its routes only. 
      routes.serverFilter("/**").order(100).beforeReplacing((request, propagatedContext) -> {
    propagatedContext.add(new MdcPropagationContext(Map.of("path", request.getPath())));
    return null;
});

      Each call declares a new server filter. The server filters of an HttpRoutes bean are read when the router is built.

      Parameters:
      patterns - The patterns of the paths to filter, in the style of the filter, ANT by default
      Returns:
      The server filter, to declare its filters on
      Since:
      5.3.0
